en: A black‑and‑white vintage postcard view framed by large stone columns and arches, looking into a sunlit courtyard with Romanesque/late Roman architecture. In the middle distance are arched arcades and an entrance between massive masonry walls, with a few people standing in the square. On the right is a building with shuttered windows and a shop sign reading "G. DEL BIANCO." At the bottom margin, white caption text identifies the scene as Split and mentions the entrance to the cathedral.
